name: Kenmore Mini B 2024
information:
**This is a short competition with only three events. It is in series with [Kenmore Mini A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KenmoreMiniA2024) and [Kenmore Mini C](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KenmoreMiniC2024), which means that you may only sign up and compete in *one*  of the three competitions.**

Due to venue capacity, we ask that competitors bring a **maximum of two guests each**. Spectators are also only permitted as companions of competitors.

This competition is recognized as an  official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KenmoreMiniB2024#37806-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
